LanguageData.RT_M48H_Vehicle.label: CM-11 Brave Tiger (M48H)
LanguageData.RT_M48H_Vehicle.description:
Taiwanese MBT combining an M48A5 turret with an M60A3 chassis and M1 Abrams fire control, armed with a 105mm M68 cannon.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Loader x1 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 105mm M68 Cannon: 105x617mmR NATO (HE / HESH / APFSDS) - .50 Cal M2 Browning: .50 BMG cartridge (FMJ / AP / Incendiary / Sabot) - 7.62mm M240 MG: 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
